text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy r2026.3 -> prod started (canary=2/3). Autoscaler: ok. Health checks: failing on canary-2, 502s from api-service. Rollout paused automatically. :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): I'm on it, paging in channel. seeing a spike in 502s and KMS errors in the canary logs.

sophie: saw alert from synthetic checks ~2m ago. error traces show SecretManager failing to return ciphertext.

carla: tagging incident-bot to open an incident.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-211, severity=P1, assigned to oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-211 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): paging @ajay for IAM/KMS help — looks like decrypt failures. logs:
```
2026-03-12T14:02:05Z ERROR secret-fetcher: failed to decrypt keyId arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01 - AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/redwood-prod-executor is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01

stack: github.com/redwood/secret-manager.(*Manager).Decrypt
  /workspace/secret/manager.go:143
```

ajay: confirm role is the task/executor role for the deployment. quick check: `aws iam get-role --role-name redwood-prod-executor` - but note we rotate keys weekly; possible new key ARN not in policy.

maria (oncall): Interesting — only canary-2 in eu-west-1 is failing; canary-1 and canary-3 (us-east-1) are healthy. suggests a region-specific key or KMS alias mismatch. Also the deploy included a config bump that points to `alias/redwood-prod-2026-03` which may have been rotated earlier today.

sophie: Confirmed — secret-reference in config: `kms_key: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:alias/redwood-prod-2026-03`. New key was created at 13:50 but IAM policy on role wasn't updated by CI because the policy attachment step failed in the release job (see `release-job-45` logs).

carla: Because CI failed to attach the new key policy, pods that try to use the new alias fail with AccessDenied. Canary instances are the first to touch that alias.

maria (oncall): Mitigation options:
- flip feature flag `ff.new_kv_cache` -> off (kill-switch) to avoid path that looks up rotated secret at runtime.
- rollback the rollout (`kubectl rollout undo`) to previous revision that uses old alias.
- emergency patch to execution role to add kms:Decrypt on new ARN (needs IAM deploy, higher blast radius).

ajay: Given time to safety, prefer rollback + suspend new key usage. We'll do rollback to remove config reference and later fix IAM in a controlled change.

maria (oncall): Starting rollback now — running: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-service --to-revision=47`

deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated by maria. Previous revision (47) has image sha: sha256:aa11.., config uses alias `alias/redwood-prod-2026-previous`. Canary set will re-evaluate.

maria (oncall): while rollback runs, toggling FF `ff.new_kv_cache` -> `off` in LaunchDarkly (kick immediate).

sophie: I turned the flag off and cold caches were bypassed. Verifying traffic now.

(2m pass)
carla: health checks returning to normal on canaries. error rate dropping.

maria (oncall): rollback completed. `kubectl rollout status deployment/api-service -n prod` shows all pods ready. Canary errors resolved.

incident-bot: INC-2026-211 status updated -> mitigated. Severity lowered to P2.

ajay: IAM root cause summary: release pipeline created new KMS key and updated config, but the IAM policy attachment step failed in `release-job-45`. As a result the prod-executor role did not get permission for the new key ARN.

maria (oncall): Customer impact: hosted-api requests that hit the new canary route in eu-west-1 experienced ~7% error rate across the window. We saw ~3 external customers open support tickets; internal telemetry shows ~80 rps to canary that spiked to 120 rps with 502s during the 6-minute window. No data exfiltration.

sophie: Noted. I'll update status page draft: "Partial errors for requests routed to canary in eu-west-1 for ~6 minutes. Customers on redirected traffic may see 502s. Fixed via rollback and feature-flag toggle."

carla: Assigning follow-up actions in INC-2026-211:
- pipeline fix: ensure `release-job-45` KMS attachment step has retry and better validation (owner: eng-releases)
- postmortem from oncall + iam (owner: maria, ajay)
- add pre-flight check in canary rollout to validate KMS decrypts for latest alias (owner: infra-runbooks)

maria (oncall): Handoff to ajay for postmortem + IAM remediation. I'm going to sleep but reachable if needed. :sleeping:

ajay: taking over. I'll coordinate IAM patch with least privileges and schedule an emergency pipeline fix. ETA for IAM patch: 90m tentative.

carla: closing incident thread in this channel; will keep updates in INC-2026-211. Great quick actions everyone — rollback + FF kill-switch avoided wider impact. :white_check_mark:
